series_key: developing smart chart objects in mql5
mechanism: CManagedTrendline wraps each OBJ_TREND into ENUM_TRENDLINE_STATE {UNKNOWN, ACTIVE, TOUCH_PENDING, BOUNCED, BROKEN, RETESTED, EXPIRED}. Touch threshold = atr*m_touch_atr_mult + proximity_pts*_Point; on closed bar 1, distance of close/high/low to projected line price enters TOUCH_PENDING. Bounce/break use separate ATR multipliers; BOUNCED returns to ACTIVE for retests while BROKEN ends the managed lifecycle in this part.
data_needed: OBJ_TREND anchors; iATR(period); open/high/low/close/time series; InpProximityPts, InpBreakATRMult, InpBounceATRMult, confirm-close counts
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol and _Period (any MT5 chart the indicator is attached to); ATR period default 14; evaluation on completed bar index 1
why_new_for_mis: Turns passive geometric levels into ATR-aware structural regime objects with explicit active/pending/bounce/broken states MIS can ingest as multi-level structure sensors.
quote: Instead of immediately changing state after a single price movement, each trendline progresses through controlled lifecycle stages.

series_key: developing smart chart objects in mql5
mechanism: In TOUCH_PENDING, Update() increments m_break_close_count when signed_diff breaches atr*break_mult+proximity beyond the line (support: close below; resistance: close above), else increments m_bounce_close_count when price moves atr*bounce_mult away on the respecting side, else resets both counters. State flips to BROKEN or BOUNCED only after N consecutive confirming closes (defaults InpBreakConfirmCloses=2, InpBounceConfirmCloses=2). Market path uses completed candles only; live-drag uses bid proximity separately.
data_needed: Closed-bar OHLC; ATR; m_break_confirm_closes / m_bounce_confirm_closes; locked m_support_context
why_new_for_mis: N-close ATR-threshold confirmation separating temporary wicks from structural break vs rejection is a reusable regime-change sensor for any geometric level.
quote: It changes state only after the confirmation counters meet the configured requirements. This allows the lifecycle engine to distinguish between temporary price movement, valid rejection, and confirmed structural failure

series_key: developing smart chart objects in mql5
mechanism: On first proximity/touch into TOUCH_PENDING, m_support_context is locked true if current_close >= expected_line_price else false (resistance). Subsequent pending resolution interprets break vs bounce asymmetrically from that locked context rather than re-deriving side each bar, so the same line is treated as support or resistance for the interaction episode.
data_needed: Projected line price at bar time; close at touch bar; boolean m_support_context
why_new_for_mis: Episode-locked S/R polarity at first touch prevents flip-flopping break/bounce logic mid-interaction—useful MIS context flag for level tests.
quote: m_support_context = (current_close >= expected_price); // Locked interaction context (true = support, false = resistance)
